crossRefs.note: Lying lips are an abomination to Yahweh, but those who do the truth are his delight.
A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.
The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouth of fools gush out folly.
The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name— he works in the arrogance of pride.
It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.
Behold, my servant will deal wisely. He will be exalted and lifted up, and will be very high.
“Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which…
Brothers, don’t be children in thoughts, yet in malice be babies, but in thoughts be mature.
Therefore don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.
Nabal answered David’s servants, and said, “Who is David? Who is the son of Jesse? There are many servants who break…
Shall I then take my bread, my water, and my meat that I have killed for my shearers, and give it to men who I don’t…
Now therefore know and consider what you will do; for evil is determined against our master, and against all his house…
Please don’t let my lord pay attention to this worthless fellow, Nabal; for as his name is, so is he. Nabal is his…
Yes also when the fool walks by the way, his understanding fails him, and he says to everyone that he is a fool.

translations.web: Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.
translations.bsb: Every prudent man acts with knowledge, but a fool displays his folly.
translations.kjv: Every prudent man dealeth with knowledge: but a fool layeth open his folly.
translations.asv: Every prudent man worketh with knowledge; But a fool flaunteth his folly.
